questions.question: Does the AppBar element have data-tour="appbar" and the model Chip have data-tour="model-chip"?
questions.expected: Yes, both attributes are present on the respective elements.

questions.question: Does the left sidebar Paper have data-tour="sidebar", the collapse button have data-tour="sidebar-toggle", and the New Chat stack have data-tour="new-chat"?
questions.expected: Yes, all three attributes are present.

questions.question: Is data-tour="conversation-card" applied only to the first conversation card in the sidebar list?
questions.expected: Yes, only index === 0 gets the attribute via the spread pattern.

questions.question: Does the Take Tour button appear at the bottom of the left sidebar with data-tour="take-tour" and a TourOutlinedIcon?
questions.expected: Yes, a ListItemButton with mt:auto pushes it to the bottom, with the icon and 'Take Tour' label.

questions.question: Do the step cards in the transcript receive data-tour attributes only on the first occurrence of each step kind?
questions.expected: Yes, the IIFE uses a seenKinds Set and tourMap to assign data-tour only once per kind.

questions.question: Does the right sidebar have data-tour attributes on the sidebar Paper, models section, temperature section, max-tokens section, and tools section?
questions.expected: Yes: right-sidebar, models-section, temperature-section, max-tokens-section, tools-section are all present.

questions.question: Is data-tour="tool-card" applied to the very first tool Paper card across both builtin and MCP tool lists?
questions.expected: Yes, builtin tools use toolIdx === 0, and MCP tools track whether builtinTools already assigned it.

questions.question: Does the Tools chip in the AppBar show the active tool count and open the right sidebar + tools section on click?
questions.expected: Yes, it renders when activeTools.length > 0 and calls updateSidebar with rightSidebarOpen and toolsSectionOpen.
